note: From the board and the pub's listings. Dates move, so check Instagram before you come.

items.title: QuizDog Pub Quiz
items.detail: Book your team through QuizDog and pay on the night.

items.title: Sip & Paint Birds
items.detail: Paint birds with Fran Giffard, the local artist whose birds hang on the walls. £10 plus a house drink.

items.title: 2-4-1 Cocktails
items.detail: Two for one, every day the pub is open.

items.title: Burger & a Bevy
items.detail: A burger and a drink, Thursdays.

items.title: Holly Dice
items.detail: Roll a double 6 and the round's free. Double 3, it's half price.

items.title: The Kids' Table
items.detail: Little ones supervised for free with table-top fun. Ages 3+, free for customers.

items.title: Big matches
items.detail: The big games are shown in the bar, the 2026 World Cup final included.

items.title: Nunhead Art Trail
items.detail: The pub hangs local work for the trail. In 2026 it showed paintings and prints by Fran Giffard and David Wightman.
